correctness.rationale: PASS: For 2n iid biased +/-1 steps, K_n is half last zero time and U_n is half the count of positive midpoint steps. Prefix conditional on last return at 2k is a uniform bridge; Chung–Feller makes positive semiduration J_k uniform 0..k. Remaining 2m-step nonreturn meander has ballot count b_mr=(r/m) binom(2m,m-r) and positive sign probability w_m=A_m+/(A_m++A_m-). The ratio b_(m+1),r/b_mr increases strictly in r and added maximum-support value gives strict MLR order for the signed terminal height; for p>1/2, w_m strictly increases above 1/2. Conditional mean n/2+m(w_m-1/2) strictly decreases in k and covariance via independent-copy identity is negative, with reflection for p<1/2, and zero at p=1/2. Independently enumerated all sign paths for n<=5 at five rational biases and verified exact sign. No finite test replaces general ballot/MLR proof.
